themes.title: Deduction and comparison
themes.description: Use a match, a weighing or a clue to narrow down possible answers.

themes.title: Sets, combinations and chance
themes.description: Classify cards by their attributes, then reason about combinations.

themes.title: Winning positions
themes.description: Choose a move, predict a reply and look for a strategy that repeats.

themes.title: Sequences of moves
themes.description: Plan a route through constrained states and compare the moves needed.

themes.title: Routes and networks
themes.description: Compare routes through a village, then draw paths subject to network rules.

themes.title: Tiling and packing
themes.description: Cover rectangles with squares, compare packings and investigate repeated square removal.

themes.title: Area and dissection
themes.description: Fix a boundary, join squares and rearrange shapes to compare their areas.

themes.title: Curves and geometric models
themes.description: Construct circles, trace moving points and investigate curved paths and surfaces.

themes.title: Spatial structures
themes.description: Inspect cube layers, construct frameworks and investigate a passage through a solid.

themes.title: Products and factors
themes.description: Start with multiplication facts, build arrays and cuboids, then reason about factors and divisors.

themes.title: Patterns and change
themes.description: Look for patterns in a table, combine values and predict the next result.

themes.title: Pictures and rules
themes.description: Use cells, parts and repeated rules to build a picture or character.

themes.title: Story worlds
themes.description: Arrange characters and objects, compare sizes and build a scene to describe.

themes.title: Programs and instructions
themes.description: Sequence commands for a route, debug a grid program and follow a tape machine.

themes.title: Codes and ciphers
themes.description: Rearrange a message, explore substitution and compare a changing cipher.

themes.title: Word patterns
themes.description: Build words from a letter set and use positional clues to rule out guesses.

sprouts.note: The game checks drawn routes; players agree when no legal move remains. No complete legal-move solver is implemented.

dobble.note: Recorded checks cover finite-plane decks and pair matches in a simulated document. Physical-device play has not been verified here.

spiral.note: Recorded checks cover the complex identity, the excluded origin and gallery modes in a simulated document. The checks do not cover rendering on a physical device.

bridge.note: The audited editor starts from truss templates. Test the design and simulation together on the intended device.

tables.note: 19 November 2026 · Desktop Chromium confirmed correct keypad feedback and score for 5 × 3. After Start at 820 × 1180, 1180 × 820 and 390 × 844 CSS pixels, the question and full keypad stayed visible, the answer field stayed read-only and the page fitted the width. Physical-tablet input remains untested.

fewest.note: 19 November 2026 · In desktop Chromium, Enter placed a 2 × 2 square on a 3 × 5 board, Undo reversed it and the next activity link opened Packing Lab. A separate controller test completes and saves a tiling. Physical-tablet play has not been checked.

packing.note: 19 November 2026 · In desktop Chromium, Rotate and Enter placed one of four pieces. See a packing showed a four-piece result with the first diagram and step controls. A separate controller test completes the board and replays the solution. Physical-tablet play has not been checked.
